claimBoundary: The template proves only that required experiment declarations are present and integrity-bound. It does not prove evaluator correctness, owner truth, semantic success, or promotion eligibility.
localizationRule: An experiment copies these declarations into its own exact local record and may add workload-specific fields. This template is incomplete evidence by itself and authorizes no experiment, product change, merge, deployment, publication, or owner-state mutation.
purpose: Require each bounded experiment to freeze its own exact evidence, baseline, evaluator, authority, stopping and reversibility contract without turning a global research method into semantic authority.
